settings.capPilot: Re-run only the 11 prior structured failures with the original saved context and Stage 1 schema at 768; diagnostic subset, not a representative new score
settings.contextBudgetCounter: Maximum of offline Llama BPE and Google SDK-selected local tokenizer; conservative shared text budget, not provider billing
settings.inference: Local Ollama only; no cloud generation, remote grading or remote token counting
settings.calibration: Freeze the complete Stage 1 classifier objects and thresholds; no fitting or selection
settings.stopAfter: Stage 2; do not start Stage 3 dev calibration

gemini.specialTokens: No automatic BOS/EOS or undocumented server chat framing
gemini.limitation: Google SDK selects this public tokenizer for Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; the local SDK is experimental/text-only. Hidden server framing and tokenizer deployment revisions are not measured by an API request.

muse-spark.limitation: Muse Spark has no public tokenizer in this project. Installed Llama 3.1 BPE counts are a documented proxy, not actual Muse Spark billed tokens.
muse-spark.specialTokens: No automatic BOS/EOS or undocumented server chat framing

Company retrieval and claim rendering change; noncompany question inputs remain frozen.
Calculator answers require complete sourced inputs, with trace citations and no model rewriting.
Baseline claim coverage is a retrospective application of the new per-claim policy; original missing-any-citation counts remain separate.
Both diagnostic context token counts are recounted using the same offline counters.
No Stage 3 or cloud API run is authorized by this study.
